finding.statement: Under the target-interface artifact contract, the required object target_interface_reference can be fully populated - nonempty interface_attempt_id, nonempty interface_claim_ids, correctly named target_subquotient and target_map_use, and a nonempty survival_or_tate_argument - by an artifact whose Tate argument concludes only under an antecedent the same field lists as an open gap. Field population is therefore not evidence of contract compliance. The substantive test must be applied to the modality of the argument's conclusion: the named source, map and subquotient must yield the stated theorem unconditionally, and a survival_or_tate_argument that is self-labelled conditional, or whose text names a gap marker as its missing hypothesis, fails the contract even when every named object is correct and no surrogate has been substituted. ATT-0122 is the witness: its source, map and subquotient are all the genuine ATT-0120 objects and no surrogate cohomology result is offered, yet the contract is not met.
